# Sandrone AI - Project Instructions

## Project Overview
Local AI chatbot with Sandrone's personality from Genshin Impact, using Ollama for uncensored LLM capabilities.

## Setup Steps
- [x] Create copilot-instructions.md file
- [x] Scaffold Python AI project structure
- [x] Create Sandrone personality configuration
- [x] Create Flask web interface
- [x] Create requirements and setup files
- [x] Create README documentation

## Project Structure
- `app.py` - Main Flask application
- `sandrone_personality.py` - Sandrone personality system
- `config.py` - Configuration settings
- `requirements.txt` - Python dependencies
- `static/` - Web interface assets
- `templates/` - HTML templates

## Development Guidelines
- Use Python 3.8+
- Ollama for local LLM backend
- Flask for web interface
- Sandrone's personality traits: intelligent, arrogant, scientist, mechanical expertise
